review_description: Where do I start? was my first question, as I knew roughly what I wanted but not the fine detail. Being provided with options from SolarQuotes.com.au got the ball rolling.The companies that provided quotes were quick on their response and willing to visit the site to provide information and most importantly the various system available.There were no high sales pitches and they provided valuable information I needed to make an 'informed decision'.I would definitely recommend SolarQuotes.com.au to provide companies that are capable and willing to provide the solar system you want.
